sources.title: Backend interview note exact three-thread ordered-print prompt
Three-thread ordering and cancellation executable validation

claims.text: The recoverable source asks for the design idea for three threads coordinating the 1,4,7... / 2,5,8... / 3,6,9... number pattern; it does not preserve a finite limit, implementation language, specific synchronization primitive, interruption contract, or output-failure policy.

Under the candidate's explicit finite-limit contract, the implementation emits exactly 1..limit globally and maps each value to its modulo-3 worker across fixed cases and 200 deterministic randomized-start stress runs.

The remediated shared cancellation state prevents the remaining workers from waiting forever when a waiting worker is interrupted or when the output callback fails; both failure paths terminate under bounded joins in the executable validation.
